areas.name: data
areas.prompt: Review this change as a data reviewer. It touches a stored or exchanged data shape: Firestore fields, a record or response type, an event payload, a migration or SQL. Look for a field renamed, removed or retyped while existing records or an older reader still depend on it, a write the reader would reject, a new required field with no value for records already stored, and an index or query the data no longer serves.

areas.name: infra
areas.prompt: Review this change as an infrastructure reviewer. It touches infrastructure code or CI workflows. Look for a resource a plan would replace or destroy when only an update is meant, a workflow step that runs with more permissions or inputs than it needs, an unpinned action or image in a job that holds credentials, a trigger that runs on untrusted input, and a change whose effect only shows after it is applied.

areas.name: cloud
areas.prompt: Review this change as a cloud reviewer. It touches permissions, quotas or budget settings. Look for a role or binding wider than the identity needs, a limit raised or removed without the reason that bounds it, a budget or spending cap that no longer stops spend, and a setting whose live value differs from what the file now says.

areas.name: security
areas.prompt: Review this change as a security reviewer. It touches identity, authentication, tokens or secrets. Look for a check that can be skipped or fails open, a signature or token compared or verified incorrectly, a secret logged, stored or sent where it should not go, an identity trusted because the caller said so, and a credential that outlives its use.
